title: Pure Crystal Beast
summary: The classic Crystal Beast cards and their Ultimate Crystal bosses, with Rainbow Bridge and generic Rank 4s, Links and staples. Crystal Beasts are placed in the Spell & Trap Zone as Continuous Spells instead of going to the GY, and the deck summons them back from there. Crystal Bond searches one Crystal Beast and places another. Crystal Beast Sapphire Pegasus places a Crystal Beast whenever it is summoned, and Ruby Carbuncle summons every Crystal Beast in your Spell & Trap Zone. Crystal Beast Rainbow Dragon, the newest card, summons itself whenever a Crystal Beast battles. Later it banishes itself from the Spell & Trap Zone to pull a Crystal Beast from the Deck and search an Ultimate Crystal monster. The 2022 Advanced Crystal Beasts send themselves to the GY unless Advanced Dark is in a Field Zone, so they stay out of this list.
